newsitem.title: UK: Further details on UK PSBR - ONS.
newsitem.headline: Further details on UK PSBR - ONS.

text.p: Britain's Public Sector Borrowing Requirement in September included a debt payment of 1.2 billion stg from the inflation uplift paid on redemption of the 2.0 percent index-linked Treasury stock 1996, the Office For National Statistics said.

Within receipts from customs and excise of 5.947 billion stg the ONS said 3.073 billion stg of value added tax receipts were gathered. This compares with 3.294 billion in August and 2.679 billion in September last year.
